_status: CORPORATE BASELINE. Inert on arrival — SpatialCodeRegistry reads it, and as of this commit only ParseLocCode/ParseZoneCode consume the LOC half. GetLevelCode is NOT yet rewired; see docs/F9_SPATIAL_CODE_RECONCILIATION.md.
_levelNote: 'code' is the STING tag code; 'isoCode' is the ISO 19650 file-name field. They are DIFFERENT ALPHABETS (GF vs 00) — see the reconciliation report. isoCode is NULL where no ISO equivalent exists (LG/UG/SB/POD/TR/AT/PL/MZ/UR/ZZ/XX); a null must make the consumer fall back explicitly rather than emit a non-ISO code into an ISO field. 'origin' is reconciled (a code some existing vocabulary already produces) or new (vocabulary this registry introduces).
_synthesisNote: L06-L99 are NOT enumerated. The loader synthesises them: code Lnn, isoCode nn, aliases 'level n' / 'ln' / ordinal. Same for SB1-SB9 from the SB entry. Enumerating 99 rows and also declaring a synthesis rule would let the two disagree.
_retiredNote: PR (Plant Room, 'Reserved') is RETIRED, not adopted. It had no producer and no consumer, PL already covers plant levels, and PR is taken elsewhere in this codebase as the Programme DOCUMENT-type code (Iso19650Vocabulary.cs:96, DocAutomationCommands.cs:195, BIMManagerCommands.cs:183). A level code colliding with a document code is the vocabulary confusion F-9 exists to end.

levels.label: No level
levels.note: Sentinel. isoCode null: ISO 19650 also uses XX, but it is asserted by the consumer, not mapped here.

levels.label: Multiple levels
levels.note: NEW VOCABULARY. Present in Iso19650Vocabulary but GetLevelCode cannot produce it; nothing infers 'spans levels' from a Revit level name. Reachable only once something sets it deliberately.

levels.label: Sub-basement
levels.note: GetLevelCode also emits SB1..SB9; the loader synthesises those from this entry.

levels.label: Lower ground
levels.note: No ISO 19650 equivalent — isoCode null so a consumer must decide rather than emit a non-ISO code into an ISO field.

levels.label: Ground floor
levels.note: THE 00->GF DECISION. code=GF is the STING tag code; isoCode=00 is the ISO 19650 field. L00 belongs to neither alphabet and is retired.

levels.label: Mezzanine 2
levels.note: NEW VOCABULARY. GetLevelCode cannot produce it — today 'Mezzanine 2' collides with 'Mezzanine' on MZ. Adopting MZ2 is the F-6 fix and WILL re-code existing tags on any model with two mezzanines.

levels.label: Plant level
levels.note: Supersedes the retired PR. No ISO equivalent.

levels.label: Upper roof
levels.note: NEW VOCABULARY. No producer today — 'Upper Roof' currently sanitises to the 12-char passthrough UPPER-ROOF, which fails the length check.

locations.label: External / site
locations.note: wordBoundary=true: EXT must not match NEXT / TEXTILE / EXTENSION. ParseLocCode already implements this guard; it is the pattern for every short code.
